evidence.field: File description; original file; licensing; file history
evidence.text: The exact file page identifies 零-seal.svg as a digital vector depicting 零 in Shuowen seal-script style, cites an S00420 source image, and lists 令 and 雨 as components. Its file history dates the vector upload to 19 December 2014. Commons marks the representation public domain, with attribution appreciated but not required. This is a modern redraw of a received seal-script form, not an ancient artifact photograph or evidence of 零’s earliest form.
evidence.title: File:零-seal.svg - Wikimedia Commons

evidence.source: Academia Sinica / Taiwan University, 小學堂 beginner guide
evidence.text: The guide says the database includes oracle-bone, bronze, Warring States, seal, and clerical forms. It explicitly applies CC0 1.0 to glyph images and glyph-attribute information obtained through its query interface. A character-specific 零 glyph could not be retrieved here, so none is proposed.

search_audit.outcome: Search returned the exact Commons file page, a Taiwan Ministry dictionary record, and Sinica’s evolution interface. Opened Commons, the character query interface, and Sinica’s rights guide. The interface returned only its shell, with no character-specific glyph.

search_audit.query: site:xiaoxue.iis.sinica.edu.tw 零 字形 零; "零-seal.svg" original image Commons 令 雨 components
search_audit.outcome: Inspected the exact Commons pages for the seal-script and Liushutong-style files. The first identifies a Shuowen seal-style redraw; the second is a separate Liushutong-style redraw. Sinica’s direct character form URL and the exact Commons original-image URL were attempted but inaccessible in the web tool.

gaps: No ancient artifact photograph or independently verified oracle-bone or bronze form of 零 was found. The Commons candidate documents a received Shuowen seal-script style only.
The exact Commons original-image link is present on the inspected file page, but directly opening that image URL failed in the web tool; the exact file page verified its identity and rights metadata.
Sinica’s character-specific query produced no glyph record in the inspected result. Its CC0 notice was verified, but it supplies no selected image for this entry.

items.period: Received Shuowen seal-script tradition; exact historical exemplar date not specified on the file page
items.caption: A modern vector redraw depicting 零 in Shuowen seal-script style; the Commons record identifies 雨 and 令 as its components. It illustrates the received seal-script form, not a verified earliest inscription form.
items.alt: Digital outline of 零 in a Shuowen seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: The exact description page identifies the character and script style, provides a direct original-file link, and documents public-domain reuse terms. It is a useful illustration of the received seal-script form while making its modern redraw status explicit.
items.rights: Public domain; attribution is appreciated but not required, according to the exact Commons file description.

limitations.text: The image is a modern vector redraw rather than an ancient artifact photograph. No verified oracle-bone or bronze 零 form was established, so this candidate cannot document the graph’s earliest development.
